findings.conclusion: Fixed: launch_monotonic is sampled immediately before Popen. Warm effective origin is launch, including initial identity/maps observation; long effective origin remains submission. Warm60/long600/browser20 constants are unchanged.

Fixed: after exact response parsing and response_check, one validated_at sample must be strictly before the same deadline. That sample is also successful RPC completion/elapsed/meets20 origin-to-finish. Later local finalization is separately recorded; late valid replies and fast invalid replies cannot pass meets20.

Unchanged original UnifiedDecisionModel.prepare, candidate_ids, DecisionRequest and make_native_payload are reused with a real local processor and CPU text-only context. No language-model constructor or generation is invoked by preparation; synthetic goldless inputs preserve ordered unfilled answer boundaries.

Fresh full2048, compact2048 and compact8192 arms share exact prepared payloads, batch/microbatch512, threads1, GPU0 and explicit cpu-mmap-only1. Native returned runtime and legal-row identities are checked; max absolute difference<=0.001 and identical argmax remain preselected.

Single-line stdout remains bounded1MiB. Stderr retains first4MiB with hash/count of observed drained bytes only. Exact wire hashes, prior exchanges and partial/error evidence are saved. Selected-model VMAs reuse the existing bounded maps bytes, retain first64 plus total observed count/virtual bytes, and do not read model content.

Successful arms request stdin EOF and require bounded normal exit0 before another arm. On failure the script closes its descriptors, preserves the primary/error evidence and stops starting arms, leaving any own live child to the parent-authorized authenticated outer unit close. No manual kill or terminate path was introduced.

The actors do not relax resource or host/observer limits. Concrete outer owner/spec and real selected runtime identities must still be reviewed separately; source tests cannot prove runtime admission, successful model load or authenticated closure.
